verification_questions.question: Do all vote write paths (handleVote, replayPendingVotes, castVote, journal replay) go through one compare-and-set on the total order (seq, created_at, rumorId) inside the per-key persistence queue, so the stored vote is the greatest regardless of call order?

Does the two-device clock-skew unit test (device B behind by 60 s, saw A, votes later with higher seq) converge on B's vote for every delivery order, queued-then-open, and replay-after-failed-ack — failing before the fix?
Is castVote's seq derived as max(stored own seq, own queued seq, 0) + 1 with casts serialised per poll, and do legacy votes (no seq) rank as seq 0 with a seq>=1 vote always winning over a legacy one?

Does parsePollVote validate seq (non-negative safe integer, else reject) and does a close-before-open get applied only when its authenticated sender equals the open's authenticated creator, discarded otherwise, with bounds/TTL as designed?

Is the chatHandler poll_close announcement gate consistent with the pending-close queue (no irrecoverable drop), AC-9 amended with the two designed sentences, docs/behavior/polls.md and the pollReplay.ts comment updated?
Unit suite + tsc green; Stryker (concurrency 1) on pollPersistence/pollHandler/pollReplay/pollSync shows no real-gap survivors; polls e2e specs and the full e2e gate pass?
